name: Aki Uso -The Only Neat Thing To Do-
original_name: アキウソ -The only neat thing to do-
source:
This is the third title in Campus’s Uso low-priced series, focusing on Eris. It follows the scenario of what happens at Mahoshi Gakuen if the magic contract didn’t end up in Satsuki’s hands and if Souichirou had protected Aoi from being taken over by the succubus.

Four years ago, Souichirou came upon a girl under a row of maple trees, with boys twice her size sprawled out the ground around her. She had crimson red eyes and radiant golden hair. He realized via his special ability of detecting lies that she was not human. The girl Eris was in fact a vampire, the only daughter of the famous Cartlet family, who had run away from home to escape her parent’s strict rules and an impending arranged marriage.

Now the two of them are really close, having lived together since that fateful meeting. One day, she did not feel well and he took care of her while she recovered. She asks him out of the blue to have sex with her. What is the true meaning behind her request?!

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2016/11/21/november-2016-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
Campus「Uso」低價系列的第三作，主角是艾莉絲。本作講述在真星學園裡，如果魔法契約沒有落到皋月手中、宗一郎保護了葵免受魅魔奪舍，會發生什麼。

四年前，宗一郎在一排楓樹下遇到一名少女，周圍躺著一群身材是她兩倍的男孩。她有猩紅色的眼睛和耀眼的金髮。靠著識破謊言的特殊能力，他意識到她並非人類。少女艾莉絲其實是著名卡特雷特家族唯一的女兒，為了逃離父母嚴苛的規矩和父母安排的婚事而離家出走。

如今，兩人自那次相遇起便共同生活，關係十分親密。某天，艾莉絲身體不適，宗一郎照顧她直到康復。她突然提出要和他做愛。她的請求究竟意味著什麼？！

[來源：[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2016/11/21/november-2016-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
